scenario: AITA for telling my sister the world does not revolve around her? | My sister is a lot younger than me and honestly I think spoiled by our parents growing up. She got to go on vacations and do other things I wasn't able to when I was a kid because my parents didn't have the money then. She's 19 now and a very controlling person. She scoffed and said the same back to me. I told her that her attitude was going to get her in trouble in the real world and she said 'think I'll be just fine, but thanks for the advice.' AITA? I don't know why she hates me so much and is so goddamn controlling.
